origin.ibarnorigins.ghaster.name: Ghaster

power.ibarnorigins.ghasterexhaust.name: ?ef wayen yeɛnan leɛqel
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterexhaust.descri: Ɣas akken tețțuɣaleḍ aț-țesɛuḍ lǧețța n ddunit, d ayen ur tezmirem ara, d azṛu-iw ur tesɛiḍ ara lweqt i deg tesɛiḍ cceṛ, tzemreḍ aț-țfeǧǧeḍ.
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterfireball.name: Immednub n tmes
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterfireball.descr: Ɣas akken i kkun-ițwaxleq i wemkan n wemkan n wemdan, ṭṭfen-kkun tazmert n lejdud-nwen iwakken aț-țesɛum lǧețțat n tmes.
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterinflate.name: ?effliḥ
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterinflate.descri: M'ara tewweḍ ɣer deffir, a k-d-yefk di tlemmast, a k-t-id-yesbeggneḍ kra n lweqt.
power.ibarnorigins.ki_immunity.name: Ad ɛeddan kra n ugellid
power.ibarnorigins.ki_immunity.descripti: Kečč ur tețțaǧǧaḍ ara deg-k sebba s wayes ara tḍuɛem.
power.ibarnorigins.kiblast.name: Aẓekka n tmes n ṛṛuḥ
power.ibarnorigins.kiblast.description: Sbeggneḍ yiwet n tmes yesɛan lǧețța ameqqran iwakken aț-țețnerniḍ tazmert m'ara tesɛiḍ leḥsab n tnefsit-ik (ițbeggin-ed di leḥsab n 100).
power.ibarnorigins.sandman_attributes.de: M'ara tbeddeḍ ɣef ṣṣifa n ṣṣifa, m'ara tesɛuḍ 50 % n leḥzen m'ara tesɛiḍ ṣṣifa. S wakka aț-țesɛuḍ daymen deg unezṛuf.
power.ibarnorigins.sandman_sandbury.name: ?eqqṛet lɣeṛb
power.ibarnorigins.sandman_sandbury.desc: Tzemreḍ aț-țesɛuḍ iman-ik ɣer ṣṣiḍar, m'ara k-t-id-yesgerɛeḍ ur teẓriḍ ara.
power.ibarnorigins.soul_speed.name: Tefsit n neṛwum
power.ibarnorigins.soul_speed.descriptio: Tezmert n ṣṣifa d lǧețțat i kkun-ițțaǧan aț-țṛuḥem iẓer.
power.ibarnorigins.soulfire_strength.des: ?ef wannect-agi 50% nniḍen n lexṣaṛ m'ara d-bedd tmes neɣ teṭṭfem lǧețțat-nsen. S wakka, times zdat-es a d-issers 100% nniḍen, 50% tmes nniḍen.
power.ibarnorigins.soulmage_fireweakness: Ɣas akken tesɛam times yelhan, times-agi ițmeslayen seg tiftilin d times tesɛiḍ deg-k lǧehd. Ula d kunwi tețwaḍeggṛeḍ cceṛ nniḍen ɣer tmes, aț-țuɣalem d aderɣal m'ara tețḍeggṛeḍ tmes.
power.ibarnorigins.soulmage_piglinfear.d: Tmes n lǧețța n tmes i tețmes deg-wen tețțawi-d lxuf ameqqran anagar lxuluq ameqqran.
power.ibarnorigins.soulmage_vegetarian.d: Leḥṛam ur yesɛi ara tazmert am lxuf ; lqut-agi ur yesɛi ara lfayda, meɛna d lḥeṛc i d-yețțaken seg wayen yelhan.
power.ibarnorigins.witherskull.name: Amur n wemkan n wemkan n wemkan
power.ibarnorigins.witherskull.descripti: Ṛuḥet lǧameɛ n wid ur nemmut ara, iwakken ad țqelliben iɛdawen-ik.
power.ibarnorigins.wp_item_prevention.de: Ur tezmirem ara aț-țelsem ula d yiwen llebsa ɛlayen akteṛ n llebsa n wutri.
power.ibarnorigins.wpairswim.name: Urrif
power.ibarnorigins.wpairswim.description: Lǧețța-k ț-țafat, tzemreḍ aț-țesliḍ deg igenni.
power.ibarnorigins.wphealth.name: Urɛad yesɛan azal
power.ibarnorigins.wphealth.description: ?ef ddemma n tlemmast-ik, lǧețța-inek tuɣaleḍ d leḥzen (5 ulawen ), ur tezmirem ara aț-țesɛuḍ aṭas n leḥṛam.
